name: Erik Marquardt - Après le § 15 - Am 4
title: SECOND REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Union agencies for the financial year 2023
part_text: 15 a. Notes that certain communications and activities of the Agency have gone beyond its mandate by promoting political narratives on asylum and migration; recalls that EU agencies must operate with full ideological neutrality and avoid advocacy or activism;
